title: Concurrent lane starts survive git's worktree lock-file race
body:
Observed 2026-11-17 under host load (npm run fast in ship-sync-main): test/cli/lane.test.ts "concurrent lane starts in one repository all succeed" failed once with `git worktree add -q --no-track -b p3 ... origin/main failed: fatal: could not open '.git/worktrees/p3/locked' for writing: No such file or directory` (exit 64); 3 isolated reruns passed. Concurrent `krn lane start` is the lead's normal parallel-lane path.
Outcome: lane start retries `git worktree add` when git reports the worktree lock-file race (cleaning the half-made admin dir), so the concurrent test passes 20 of 20 runs under parallel load.
Proof: a unit test feeding the verbatim stderr above to the lane-start retry path exits 0 and shows one retry.
